name: Kothrud
summary: A large, established residential suburb in west-central Pune. It has many schools, colleges and businesses, and older buildings are being redeveloped.
knownFor: ARAI on Vetal Tekdi hill and the long-running Cummins Kothrud engine plant
Mrutyunjayeshwar Temple, dating from Peshwa times
connectivity: Karve Road links Kothrud to Deccan and the city centre; Paud Road runs to Chandani Chowk
Pune Metro Line 2 (Aqua): Vanaz, Anand Nagar and Ideal Colony stations, operating since 2022
suits: Families wanting an established neighbourhood with schools and colleges and a metro link to the city centre.
